description: Grouped entry point for memory I/O, screen reads, and screen polling.

inputSchema.description:
Memory operations.

Operations:
- read: Read a range of bytes with address metadata. Required inputs: address. Optional inputs: length, format, bank.
- write [write]: Write hex bytes into RAM. Required inputs: address, bytes. Optional inputs: verify, expected, mask, abortOnMismatch.
- read_screen: Return the 40x25 text screen as ASCII.
- wait_for_text: Poll the screen for a substring or regex. Required inputs: pattern. Optional inputs: isRegex, caseInsensitive, timeoutMs, intervalMs.
- wait_until: Wait until a condition on memory, the screen or a VICE checkpoint holds. Timeout or maxIterations: success with met false. A failed read ends the wait with a communication_failure error carrying the data so far. Addresses and backend are fixed at the start. Required inputs: condition, timeoutMs. Optional inputs: pollIntervalMs, maxIterations, includeIo.
- list_basic: List the BASIC program in memory as text.
- disassemble: Disassemble memory into 6502/6510 instructions, with loaded labels. Required inputs: address. Optional inputs: length, instructionCount.
- copy_memory [write]: Copy a RAM region to another address. Required inputs: source, dest, length. Optional inputs: includeIo.
- fill_memory [write]: Fill a memory range with a repeating byte pattern. Required inputs: address, length, pattern.
- search_memory: Search a memory range for a byte pattern. Required inputs: startAddress, endAddress, pattern. Optional inputs: maxResults, includeIo.
- compare_memory: Compare two memory regions and report differences. Required inputs: address1, address2, length. Optional inputs: maxDiffs, includeIo.
- save_memory [write]: Dump a memory range to a local file (optional PRG header). Required inputs: startAddress, endAddress, filePath. Optional inputs: asPrg, includeIo.

abortOnMismatch.description: Abort the write on pre-write mismatch.

address.description: Start address: $HHHH, 0xHHHH, decimal, a loaded program label or documented name (screen, CHROUT), optionally +n or -n.

address1.description: First region start address, in the same forms as address.

address2.description: Second region start address, in the same forms as address1.

asPrg.description: Prepend a 2-byte load address (PRG). Default true.

bytes.description: Hex bytes to write, like $AABBCC or AA BB CC.

dest.description: Destination start address, in the same forms as source.

endAddress.description: End of the search range (inclusive), in the same forms as startAddress.

expected.description: Hex data expected before the write.

format.description: hex (default) or dump (16 bytes per line, PETSCII).

includeIo.description: Ultimate: allow $D000-$DFFF. Limits depend on op.

instructionCount.description: Stop after this many instructions; replaces length.

length.description: Bytes to read (default 256). Limits depend on op.

mask.description: Verification mask (hex); only set bits are compared.

pattern.description: Substring or regex to find (max 200 chars; ^ and $ match at row boundaries) Limits depend on op.

source.description: Source start address, in the same forms as address.

startAddress.description: Start of the search range, in the same forms as address.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout ms (wait_for_text 1-120000) Limits depend on op.

verify.description: Read before and after to verify.

name: c64_memory
title: Reads or writes RAM, captures the screen, or waits for text matches in one tool.
